jobs.description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. Das Ergebnis: 7 von 10 Kandidaten, die wir einreichen, landen im Interview. Der Markt liegt bei 10–20 %. Dein Job: reines Delivery. Du bekommst die Mandate. Du lieferst die Menschen. Punkt. jobs.title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
jobs.description: Background Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice. Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification.
